auth_model.scheme: Keycloak OIDC (authorization-code, browser redirect) -> Bearer JWT on /api/v1/*
auth_model.coverage: Every app route requires an authenticated session (unauthenticated -> Keycloak redirect). API requests carry: authorization: Bearer <token>, accept: application/json, content-type: application/json, x-service-name (pieq-react-app | pieq-insurance-app), x-client-id: pieq-app-dev. Unauthenticated API fetch -> 401 (captured). Per-route RBAC not observable from this black-box repo. Roles are env-keyed: E2E_EMAIL (ops manager), E2E_EMAIL_AGENT (agent), E2E_EMAIL_OWNER (agency owner), E2E_EMAIL_SALES_LEADER (sales leader), password E2E_PASSWORD.
auth_model.public_surface: Keycloak login flow only (appPaths.ts:28). No other public route confirmed.
